تستقصصن (form X)
# تَسْتَقْصِصْنَ (tastaqṣiṣna) /tas.taq.sˤisˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
# تُسْتَقْصَصْنَ (tustaqṣaṣna) /tus.taq.sˤasˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
